title: The Ellenton Formation in South Carolina; a revised age designation from Cretaceous to Paleocene
citation: Prowell, D.C., Edwards, L.E., and Frederiksen, N.O., 1985, The Ellenton Formation in South Carolina; a revised age designation from Cretaceous to Paleocene: U.S. Geological Survey Bulletin 1605-A [p. A63-A69], map scale 1:46,571.
notes:
Out of scope: the PDF is the whole USGS Bulletin 1605-A; pages 1-35 hold the front matter and other authors' notes (California, Nevada, Mississippian time scale, Grand Canyon, Kentucky-Tennessee). This record's note is PDF pages 69-75 (A63-A69). Nothing recorded from this packet.
Out of scope: the PDF is the whole USGS Bulletin 1605-A; pages 36-68 hold other authors' notes (Appalachian black shales, Georgia/North Carolina thrust sheets, etc.). This record's note is PDF pages 69-75 (A63-A69). Nothing recorded from this packet.
The PDF is the whole USGS Bulletin 1605-A (Stratigraphic Notes, 1984). This record is only the Ellenton Formation note, PDF pages 69-75 (report pages A63-A69); pages 77-84 (central Massachusetts note) were not recorded. Figure 2 correlation chart (p. 71) is garbled and was not read. References limited to SC/Georgia Coastal Plain and Paleocene biostratigraphy entries.
